prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a hit while turning left. The patient had 20 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1227; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Nearly all findings rest on the patient's own pain reports; imaging and exam tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presents following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was struck while turning left. Presenting complaints are neck and back strain. The reported mechanism and force of impact are consistent with the injuries described. No prior injury to the cervical or lumbar regions is known to this provider. Care was delivered over twenty visits, following a typical conservative course of manual therapy, stretching, and home exercise instruction. Treatment was gradually reduced in frequency as symptoms improved. Subjective pain reporting forms the basis for nearly all documented findings, as cervical and lumbar imaging and standard examination maneuvers were within normal limits. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no duplicate or repeated billing observed. Prognosis is favorable with continued self-directed exercise and periodic reassessment as needed.
